stages.name: Oxide production
stages.subtitle: SPL → oxide
stages.note: SPL uses 25 kg per bar; oxide actual is currently inferred from paste-mixing withdrawal.

stages.name: Paste mixing
stages.subtitle: Oxide preparation
stages.note: Mixing scrap is an illustrative 0.6% estimate of oxide input; the source map has no weighed mixing scrap or output.

stages.name: Strip casting
stages.subtitle: HOGS → grid
stages.note: HOGS uses an assumed 850 kg per bar; weighing and trimmings measurements are not yet available.

stages.name: Pasting
stages.subtitle: Oxide + grid
stages.note: Demo difference is assigned here to illustrate exception handling. Scrap paste is collected weekly in the source process.

stages.name: Drying & stacking
stages.subtitle: Plate preparation
stages.note: Scrap plates are weight-confirmed daily in the source map; good output is based on BOM weight.

stages.name: Curing
stages.subtitle: Cured plates
stages.note: Cured output is declared in pieces in the source process. This demo models kilograms and uses an illustrative 0.5 kg per plate to display an approximate count; production needs an approved SKU/BOM conversion.
